negative_results: Naive always-expand graph HYBRID_V1 produced approximately 1.3% Top-1 despite 100% Recall@5; rejected as default strategy.
Adaptive V2 before exact logical anchoring produced approximately 67.3% Top-1 and 0% provenance Top-1.
Harder V3 before traversal-depth/target-type intent produced approximately 80.1% Top-1 and 0% GRAPH_2HOP Top-1.
An initial large run exceeded the 45-second local tool execution budget because the LIKE baseline scaled poorly.
scope_note: Synthetic held-template/phrase-variant natural-language context retrieval benchmark. It compares explicit tested baselines only; it is not evidence of superiority over every database, retrieval product, vector model, graph engine, or production workload.
